universities.name: University of Information Technology (UIT)
universities.description: Myanmar's premier specialized university in Information Technology, Software Engineering, AI, and Cybersecurity.
universities.admission: Admission is highly competitive based strictly on total matriculation examination marks.

universities.name: Yangon Technological University (YTU)
universities.description: The flagship engineering institution in Myanmar with state-of-the-art engineering laboratories and prestigious COE programs.
universities.admission: COE admission requires top-tier matriculation total marks and prerequisite scores in English, Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry.

universities.name: West Yangon Technological University (WYTU)
universities.description: Major engineering university serving western Yangon, offering comprehensive Bachelor of Engineering programs.
universities.admission: Selection is based on matriculation examination scores in the 4-subject combination (English, Maths, Chemistry, Physics).

universities.name: Technological University, Thanlyin (TTU)
universities.description: Prominent technological university in the Thanlyin industrial corridor specializing in engineering degrees.
universities.admission: Admission based on matriculation marks, prioritizing applicants who meet the departmental cutoff in technical combinations.

universities.name: Technological University, Hmawbi (HBTU)
universities.description: Leading engineering university located in northern Yangon region.
universities.admission: Admission determined through matriculation marks with 4-subject requirement benchmarks.

universities.name: University of Computer Studies (UCSY)
universities.description: Pioneering computer science and technology university offering B.C.Sc and B.C.Tech degrees.
universities.admission: Merit-based admission from the matriculation examination. Requires high aptitude and score in Mathematics and English.

universities.name: University of Medicine 1 (UM1)
universities.description: The most prestigious and oldest medical school in Myanmar, training leading physicians and surgeons.
universities.admission: Admission requires the highest matriculation cutoff scores in Myanmar, with special minimum thresholds in English, Chemistry, and Biology.

universities.name: University of Medicine 2 (UM2)
universities.description: Premier medical university in eastern Yangon with extensive clinical facilities and research departments.
universities.admission: Direct selection of top-scoring science matriculation graduates based on English, Chemistry, and Biology combined scores.

universities.name: University of Pharmacy (UOPY)
universities.description: Dedicated pharmaceutical university producing pharmacists and pharmaceutical research specialists.
universities.admission: Admission based on high matriculation scores with strong marks in Chemistry, Biology, and English.

universities.name: University of Medical Technology
universities.description: Trains specialized medical laboratory technologists, radiographers, and physiotherapists.
universities.admission: Competitive selection based on science stream matriculation scores in Chemistry, Biology, and Physics.

universities.name: University of Dental Medicine
universities.description: Leading institution for dental surgery, oral health sciences, and orthodontics.
universities.admission: Admission requires top matriculation scores with specific cutoff criteria in English, Chemistry, and Biology.

universities.name: University of Nursing
universities.description: Dedicated to advancing nursing sciences and healthcare delivery in Myanmar.
universities.admission: Admissions selected by matriculation score benchmarks with preference for applicants committed to nursing sciences.

universities.name: University of Public Health
universities.description: Center for epidemiology, community health, and public health policy.
universities.admission: Selection based on matriculation examination scores in science and arts combinations.

universities.name: Yangon University of Foreign Languages (YUFL)
universities.description: Myanmar's premier foreign language academy offering degree programs in 8 major international languages.
universities.admission: Direct admission based on matriculation overall marks with high weighting on English language scores.

universities.name: Yangon University of Economics (Hlaing)
universities.description: Top university in Myanmar for commerce, accounting, business administration, and economic statistics.
universities.admission: High cutoff requirement on matriculation scores with strong scores in Mathematics and English.

universities.name: Yangon University of Economics (Ywar Thar Gyi)
universities.description: Expansive economics campus delivering high-quality business, finance, and public administration degrees.
universities.admission: Admission determined through matriculation aggregate marks across commerce and economics specializations.

universities.name: Co-operative University, Thanlyin
universities.description: Specialized university focusing on regional economics, microfinance, marketing, and business management.
universities.admission: Standard matriculation score cutoff across arts, science, and commerce streams.

universities.name: Yangon University of Education (YUOE)
universities.description: Historic university dedicated to pedagogical training, educational science, and teacher development.
universities.admission: Admission based on matriculation marks with specific gender quotas and academic interview requirements.

universities.name: Myanmar Maritime University (MMU)
universities.description: Myanmar's specialized maritime university offering international standard maritime and naval engineering degrees.
universities.admission: Competitive selection requiring high matriculation marks in English, Mathematics, Chemistry, and Physics, followed by physical fitness evaluation.

universities.name: Myanmar Mercantile Marine College (MMMC)
universities.description: Renowned college training maritime officers, deck officers, and marine engineers.
universities.admission: Admission based on matriculation marks, medical clearance, and seamanship entrance aptitude testing.

universities.name: National Management Degree College (NMDC)
universities.description: Modern college specializing in Business Management, Tourism & Hospitality, Journalism, and Professional English.
universities.admission: Selection based on matriculation aggregate marks with high scoring in English and general subjects.

universities.name: National University of Arts and Culture (NUAC)
universities.description: Preserves and promotes Myanmar traditional performing arts, music, dramatic arts, painting, and sculpture.
universities.admission: Admission based on matriculation pass certificates and artistic aptitude testing (auditions/portfolio reviews).

universities.name: University of Yangon
universities.description: The crown jewel of higher education in Myanmar, renowned for arts, pure sciences, law, and international relations.
universities.admission: Selection is highly competitive based on matriculation examination scores into specific honors and degree departments.

universities.name: Dagon University
universities.description: One of the largest universities in Myanmar by student population, offering 20+ disciplines across science and arts.
universities.admission: Direct selection based on matriculation marks according to departmental quotas across arts and science.

universities.name: University of Veterinary Science
universities.description: The sole veterinary medicine institution in Myanmar granting the Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (B.V.Sc.) degree.
universities.admission: Admission based on high matriculation scores in Biology, Chemistry, and English.

universities.name: University of Traditional Medicine
universities.description: Myanmar's university dedicated to Indigenous Traditional Medicine, herbal pharmacology, and holistic healthcare.
universities.admission: Selection based on matriculation marks in science and arts combinations.

programs.name: National University of Arts and Culture Programs
Marine Electrical System and Electronics Engineering (MESE)
